title: A polytechnic audits a city's sensors
text:
A polytechnic group audited the sensors a city relies on, and published what it found.

The applied research group at Bellhaven Polytechnic tested one hundred and forty municipal air sensors and reported that nineteen of them had drifted far enough to be misleading.

Theo Baptiste, who directs the group, said the point of the audit was not to embarrass anyone but to establish what a reasonable recalibration interval looks like for hardware left outdoors in Texas.

The report was published on 18 June 2025. The city has since funded a recalibration programme and asked the group to repeat the audit in two years.
